messages:
Zara: quick flag from QA — settings modal looks cramped on small viewports. header and body spacing feels inconsistent. screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/modal-tight-2.png
Liam: yep, noticed too. can we add a `modal-breath` token with `compact` (12px) and `default` (20px)? use `compact` for inline panels only.
Anya: accessibility: close icon hit target is under 24px on small screens. keep visual 24px but expand hit area to 44px via padding+negative margin. add `aria-label=\"Close settings\"`.
Rex: toasts are mounting inside the modal and occasionally steal focus. propose `toast.portal = true` so toasts mount at `#global-toast-root`. default anchor: top-right desktop, bottom-center mobile. avoid selectors: ['.modal', '.fixed-footer'].
Zara: microcopy note: primary says "Confirm" but action applies settings. prefer "Apply changes" and toast text `Changes applied`. mirror CTA in toast.
Liam: motion/accessibility: respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for toasts and modal transitions. reduced motion -> instant show. also add unit tests for 360px and 1024px to avoid regressions.
Anya: focus behavior: toasts should be non-focusable (aria-live polite). when modal is open, focus must remain trapped inside. errors can be assertive but should not move focus.
Rex: i'll open a small PR: add `modal-breath` tokens, `hit-target-44` util, and `toast.portal` boolean. include changelog and a11y checklist.
DesignBot: visual snapshot queued for modal-breath + toast-portal (run id: e7d1a).
Zara: thanks team — please document usage in Modal and Toast component READMEs. :thumbsup:
